name: Liberty  Mutual
desc:
(WRO Can Help You Get Licensed)  Licensed Customer Service Representative | $47,500 - $63,500/yr typical starting (roughly $22.84 - $30.53/hr estimate) | Inbound, No Sales Expectations
Company: Liberty Mutual
Industry: Insurance
What Your Day Will Look Like:
 You'd be on the phone helping policyholders and agents with their Personal Lines insurance, things like auto or home policies. Someone calls in with a question or an issue on their policy, and you're the one figuring out the answer, solving what you can on the spot, and looping in someone else when it's outside your scope. It's steady phone based customer service, but with an insurance license behind it, so you're not just reading from a script, you're actually working with real policy details and helping people protect what matters to them.
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements
 Education Minimum: Not explicitly required, though an Associate's degree is listed as preferred
Required Experience: 2+ years of related customer service experience, and an active P&C Producers insurance license
Preferred Experience: Associate's degree or 1+ year of insurance experience
Required Skills:
Ability to review, record, and organize written data from a variety of sources with no set format
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
Active P&C Producers insurance license (required, not preferred)
Comfort independently solving policy related problems and knowing when to escalate

Best Fit
 This role is ideal for:
A participant who has already earned or is close to earning their P&C license through your insurance pathway
Someone with 2+ years of customer service experience, even outside insurance (hospitality, retail, call center backgrounds are explicitly welcomed in this posting)
Someone comfortable with a weekend rotation schedule
Someone who can meet the wired internet requirements listed below
Not a Good Fit for:
Anyone without an active P&C Producers license, this is a hard requirement, not a preference
Anyone under 2 years of customer service experience
Anyone who cannot work a weekend rotation shift

Top 10 Resume Keywords:
P&C Producers license
Personal lines insurance
Policyholder support
Customer service
Problem resolution
Data organization and documentation
Insurance industry
Remote customer service
Interpersonal communication
Escalation handling
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
Application
Expect an assessment at the end of the application or directly emailed to you
If the assessment is passing, expect a recruiter to reach out via email or text for a phone screen
If the phone screen passes, expect a final interview
Total time to hire from date of application can be anywhere from 3 to 15 days on average.
4-5 interview questions for this role:
Tell us about a time you helped a customer solve a problem you didn't have a script for.
Walk us through your experience holding a P&C insurance license, even if it's outside a full time insurance role.
How do you stay organized when documentation doesn't follow a set format?
This role includes a required weekend rotation, how do you feel about that kind of schedule?
What draws you to insurance customer service, especially if your background is in a different industry?
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:
Pay: Typical starting range is $47,500 to $63,500 per year, with a full posted range of $42,000 to $76,000 depending on experience and other factors. That works out to roughly $22.84 to $30.53 per hour as an estimate based on a standard work year
Shift: Paid training runs Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:30 PM EST, full time, with mandatory attendance. After training, go-forward shifts start between 11:00 AM and 1:30 PM EST with a required weekend rotation, one Saturday or Sunday each week with an alternate weekday off
Benefits: 15 days of flexible time off annually. Full benefits details are not listed in the posting, refer participants to Liberty Mutual's general benefits page for more
Equipment Provided: Yes, all equipment is provided. Participant is responsible for dependable wired internet with at least 5Mbps upload and 25Mbps download, plus a quiet, distraction free workspace
Felony Friendly?: No
Drug Test: Not stated

Career Pathway: Remote Licensed Customer Service Representative → Senior Customer Service Representative → Team Lead or Claims/Underwriting Support roles within Liberty Mutual
